messages.title: 筆 Dev log #3 · The Workshop opens
body: It is in the game. Thank you to everyone who answered the preview in {#ideas}: what changed because of you is below.
fields: 業 The Workshop

A new tab from realm 2: seven crafts you level from 1 to 99. Gather herbs and ore, render the parts of the beasts you hunt, and forge metal, tools and the gear you choose. It keeps working 12 hours after you close the game.
丹 符 陣 Further up

Alchemy opens at realm 5, Sigil Writing at 6 and Arrays at 7. An elixir and a sigil go into your next warden, heart demon or vault gate, and only a win spends them. The arena says which: spent on a win, kept on a loss.
畫 Painted

Every herb, ore, metal, elixir, sigil, array and tool is painted in the same ink as the beasts, and each craft has its own scene. On a phone the pouch is its own view, one shelf per kind. On a PC the crafts and the pouch sit side by side.
守 What it never does

Nothing the workshop makes raises your qi rate, and a lost fight never spends your kit. We played the whole climb with it and without it, and it lands within two days either way. A second road, not a shortcut.
圍 The drive costs time now

One minute of your own gathering per kill, in every realm: 50 kills are 50 minutes. A beast from an earlier realm costs a quarter of that. Late in the climb, fifty kills used to cost more than a whole day of qi.
初 A faster first realm

The first realm is now your first sitting: the hound, the frog and the fox come within about a quarter of an hour, and gear, the Path and the workshop open right after. A player on Reddit told us the first minutes were one rat after another, and they were right. Thank you. Already past realm 1? Nothing changes for you.
議 Tell us
Everything about the workshop can still change. Tell us what you think in *業 The Workshop: tell us what you think*, in {#ideas}. How every craft works is in {#guides}.
謝 Thanks
To Raziel, for the jobs thread and for the word about the drive. And to everyone posting in {#bugs} and {#ideas}: every post is read.

posts.title: 業 The Workshop: seven crafts, 1 to 99
body: **The workshop is a second road beside the climb.** Seven crafts, each levelled from 1 to 99. Set it on one thing and it repeats that on its own, while you play and for 12 hours after you close the game. Past 12 hours it simply stands still: nothing is lost for being away.
fields: ▸ 藥 Herb Gathering · 礦 Vein Delving
Realm 2. Herbs from the paths of every realm you have reached, and ore from their veins. They need only time.
▸ 解 Rendering
Realm 2. Kill ten of a common beast (one, for a warden) and the workshop knows what its kind leave behind: a pelt, a fang, a scale. From then on it renders that part for as long as you let it.
▸ 鑄 Forging

Realm 2. Smelt metal from ore, forge a tool for each craft (each step is 5% faster), and forge gear: the piece you choose, in the shape a beast teaches. A forged piece is bound. It cannot be fused, and melting it gives 2 metal back, never qi.
▸ 丹 Alchemy
Realm 5. Elixirs of Mending, Guarding and Might for every realm, and three rare ones. Each Alchemy level also takes 0.2% off the pill furnace's material.
▸ 符 Sigil Writing

Realm 6. One-use sigils for a hard fight (Warding, Thunder, Binding, Mirror, Five Thunders), Purity and Soul-Lock for the heart demon, and the Seeking Sigil: the next beast you beat on the hunt is sure to leave a piece.
▸ 陣 Arrays

Realm 7. Cut once and kept for good, placed in the cave floor: 3 places, a 4th at level 50 and a 5th at 99. Faster crafts, more experience, a sooner vault door, lighter blows in a hard fight, four more hours of work while you are away.
▸ 攜 Carrying

One elixir and one sigil go into your next warden, heart demon or vault gate, and the odds on the card count them. A win spends one of whatever took part; a loss spends nothing, and the arena says which. Never the Dragon, never the tower, never a common beast. A thing made for an earlier realm is worth half as much for each realm above it.
▸ 品 Quality and 習 familiarity

Elixirs, sigils and gear come in the five gear ranks, better the further your level is above the recipe. Making the same thing earns five marks, at 25, 100, 300, 800 and 2000 made: faster, sometimes two at once, one fewer of the first ingredient, and at the fifth never Common.
▸ ⏳ How long
The first levels come in minutes. About 1,550 hours of work take one craft to 99, with a rank every ten levels and a title at the top.

edits.field: ▸ The guide in the game walks you through this
edits.value:
1. Spend the qi your master left you on an upgrade.
2. Win your first fight: the rat.
3. Spend the 材 material it drops on 妖丹 Beast Cores.
4. Kill the same beast ten times, for its 熟 Known mark.
5. Fill the ninth layer, beat the realm's warden, and break through.
Played straight through, the first realm takes about a quarter of an hour.
